causal_observations.subject: Roshan personal arc
causal_observations.finding: The wish to be heard begins with her small note. Listening locates Duri and protects him; later Roshan calls for help, uses Duri's three taps, coordinates a changed plan and leaves a space for the city's answer.

causal_observations.subject: Bridge rescue, pages 9-14
physical_beats: Distinguish loud empty echo from faint tapping and choose the kelp arch
Recognise tram pulse, hold pillar, then enter one at a time
Find trapped Duri; first push tightens banner; Roshan stops it
Reverse a small crate motion to slacken cloth; Rumi lifts loop off shell
New tram pulse shifts crate and spills bells
Roshan returns to bracing Duri while Nari tracks basket; belongings wait
Sideways clearance opens exit; Duri actively paddles backward
Hana settles second crate on flat stone; Rumi scoops bells and basket; Duri accepts shared carrying
causal_observations.reversal: A gained state (free banner loop) does not end rescue. The tram rush changes support and threatens possessions; Roshan chooses to keep Duri safe.

causal_observations.subject: Current-arch battle, pages 21-28
physical_beats: Ask imps to move props onto visible safe ledge; refusal initiates obstruction
Bubble wall blocks approach; Hana catches soft foam star
Nari leaves a beat; Roshan follows low current between puffs
Roshan and Rumi permanently clear two independently supported small crates
Return star softly; imps land on cushions; bigger puff hides arch
Roshan's straight pull skews final crate onto short jamb projection; she stops and taps for help
Duri identifies snag; team rotates crate with banner slack until corner is clear
Rumi and Roshan pull with Hana supporting; final crate slides to ledge; Duri resumes delivery
causal_observations.reversal: Two crates removed is real persistent progress. Final crate fails through geometry, requiring a changed turn-before-slide method rather than more force.

causal_observations.subject: Existing magic and geography
causal_observations.finding: Music room connects to stage arch and then shops, bathhouse and tram. Crates obstruct the existing singing current. Tram pulses remain local water movements. No new power source or song attack resolves the obstacle.

causal_observations.subject: Crate count and persistence
causal_observations.finding: Two bridge crates settle at bridge. Three separate stage crates are two small forward crates and one large rear crate. The first two remain on right ledge; the third joins them after clearing the short side jamb projection.

causal_observations.subject: Imp conflict and amends
causal_observations.finding: Imps want the biggest show and refuse to make room; their larger puff worsens the obstruction. Soft landings preserve the playful tone. They learn why neighbours could not answer and perform practical tidying before joining the ensemble.

character_roles.Rumi: Invites and supports Roshan, lifts cloth, keeps Duri safe during pulse, recovers delivery after release, leads singing and assists final pull.
character_roles.Hana: Learns controlled movement and making room, holds and settles bridge crate, catches foam star, supplies banner and turns final crate.

character_roles.Duri: Refuses then accepts shared carrying, actively backs out, guides courier passage, identifies Roshan's taps and caught crate corner, confirms clearance and delivers answers.
